auftrag: Read the case file and Agent Wren's notes. Then solve five puzzles.

saetze: It is small, round and very old.
It was a present from a king, and it can point to secret places on old maps.
For that reason it is worth a lot of money, and for the Academy it is priceless.
The compass was kept in the Map Room on the second floor.
Dr Cole saw it there on Monday at six pm.
At seven pm Agent Wren locked the room herself.
On Tuesday morning the compass was gone, but the door was still locked and no window was broken.
Three people have a key: Agent Wren, Mr Hale and Dr Cole.
Sam, the cook, brings lunch to the Academy every day, but he has never had a key.
A note was lying on the table where the compass used to be.
It says: Take the nine forty-two train to Brighton.
So somebody with a key took the compass, or somebody opened the door and locked it again.
The note looks like a trap.
Perhaps it was left on purpose, so that we run to Brighton and forget to look closer to home.
